text:
kari-partners: Quick sync request 52 inbound from BlueMarlin. They want two marketplace SKUs: Hosted API (Day 0) and a signed-download BYOW SKU with optional escrow release and geo-based gating. Also asked about KMS-wrapped artifacts and key rotation implications. Can Legal + SI + HW align on gating + announcement cadence?

oliver-legal: High-level: hosted API is low friction. For signed-downloads we need a redistribution addendum, explicit escrow release trigger language, and a provenance warranty. Also require partner to keep signature/audit logs for 12-24 months (TBD). Will draft required clause.

mira-solutions: SI perspective: require a sealed "SI bundle": artifact tar.gz, manifest.json, detached signature(s), verification script, and optional quant_report.pdf if claiming edge perf. Manifest should include provenance_chain, signer_key_id, signature_type, kms_refs, and any geo_restrictions.

ben-hw: Hardware note: if partner claims quantized edge perf we should run a validation on our EdgeRack and XSeries nodes. We'll need the quant table and artifacts. Also callout: some NIC/firmware combos affect mmap and perf; we'll note in report.

kari-partners: Partner also asked if KMS rotation during marketplace embargo blocks the SKU. They can provide either a KMS ARN reference or an encrypted sealed_key blob.

oliver-legal: Rotation alone won't block listing, but manifest must include rotation history (key IDs + timestamps) and verification steps. Add warranty that partner will retain key rotation audit trail for 18 months and provide it on request. Also add indemnity carveout for provenance misclaims.

mira-solutions: We should require an SPDX-like provenance_chain field in the manifest. Sample mock they sent (sanitized):

```
{
  "model_name": "bluemarlin-13b",
  "version": "2026-08-10",
  "artifact_digest": "sha256:bb11cc...",
  "provenance_chain": [
    {"name":"training-archive-1","uri":"s3://bm-share/train-1","sha":"sha256:aa22"}
  ],
  "signatures": [
    {"algo":"pgp","key_id":"0xBEEF1234","type":"detached","sig":"..."}
  ],
  "kms_refs": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/zzzz-aaaa"],
  "rotation_history": ["2026-07-01:key-0x111","2026-08-01:key-0xBEEF"],
  "geo_restrictions": ["EU"]
}
```

mira-solutions: We'll map this schema to our SI packaging spec and include a verification helper (gpg + sha256sum).

ben-hw: I'll schedule a validation window. Suggest partner upload artifacts to our secure bucket and give us read-only access. Tentatively can run tests next Thu/Fri.

kari-partners: Announcement ask: partner wants a co-announcement (blog + demo). Suggest we list hosted API Day 0 and mark BYOW as "coming soon" until addendum + escrow proof are done. Thoughts?

oliver-legal: Agree with two-track approach. For co-announcement we must ensure BYOW availability only after the addendum is signed and escrow accepts the artifact. We'll add a clause about embargoed materials and partner obligations.

mira-solutions: Docs action: add a quickstart stub showing verification steps and KMS examples (AWS KMS unwrap + on-prem HSM URN example). Also include sample command to verify detached signature.

ops-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5244 to track BlueMarlin BYOW gating, KMS references, and escrow integration  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5244

docs-bot: created PR #912 to add SI bundle verification stub (gpg verify + sha256)  https://redwood.company/pr/912

ben-hw: Note for SI: if partner provides sealed_key for enclave use, we need lifecycle docs. If sealed_key changes because of KMS rotation, SI must re-run verification. Please document.

oliver-legal: I'll prepare the addendum template with redistribution + escrow release trigger + rotation audit requirement + liability cap. Target: draft by Mon COB.

mira-solutions: I'll prepare SI bundle template and the verification snippet (example below):

```
# verify_bundle.sh
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
gpg --verify signature.sig artifact.tar.gz
```

kari-partners: Commercials: partner proposed a modest listing fee + rev-share for paid downloads. We'll capture commercial separately; legal/tech work proceeds in parallel.

ben-hw: Action: I'll confirm validation slot and post results to PARTNERS-5244.

kari-partners: Recap: Oliver drafts addendum, Mira prepares SI bundle + docs stub, Ben schedules HW validation, partner to upload artifacts to secure bucket. We'll reconvene after addendum + artifacts land. Thanks all.
